Prevention: Rice field sanitation (plough soil up and over to expose to the sun)
Avoid susceptible varieties in the hot spots for bacterial blight disease (e.g.
RD47, RD41, PSL2, KDML105, RD15 and
If sowing use seed rate of 15-20 kg/rai
Nitrogen fertilizer(<25 kg/rai in fertile soil)
If need to apply fertilizer, split fertilizer application 2 times (~10 kg/rai each time)
Crop rotation (not with peanut or mungbean)
Plant no more than 2 rice crops/year
Monitoring: Regularly visit rice field every two weeks (if 10% disease incidence/area need to control)

Monitor conditions to be prepared for disease outbreak: monitor the weather such as temperature (28ºC), humidity (RH over 80%), heavy raining (high level of water in the rice field and windy). clay soil and fertile field will be favourable for disease development and epidemic
Direct Control: Do not drain water from infected rice field to another rice field to reduce source of infection in irrigated rice area
Restrictions: WHO II WHO II WHO II
Apply bactericide when 10% of disease incidence found in the rice field.
